preregistration.stop_rule: A promotion cell fails if either independent repeat has a P50, P95, or P99 winner other than its pre-registered variant, or if the expected winner's margin over its runner-up is below 2% at any required percentile. Any failed promotion cell makes the global decision STOP; the record-only cell never changes that decision.
preregistration.correctness_rule: For every case and raw ABI contract, vshard2_p2 and vshard4_p2 must be bitwise exact to baseline for output and, when present, final state. For every case and public contract, baseline must also be bitwise exact to the pinned Torch reference.
